+def send_text(text: str, name: str) -> Response:
+    """Send ``text`` to the client as a downloadable plain text file.
+
+    :param text: The text to send, encoded as UTF-8.
+    :param name: The file name the browser will use when saving.
+    """
+    # The download name is passed positionally so this call does not
+    # depend on the keyword name of that send_file parameter.
+    return send_file(io.BytesIO(text.encode()), "text/plain", True, name)
